appearancePolicy: Physical photos outrank CAD defaults. Hex values are approximate sRGB render inputs, not calibrated measured colors. Metallic/roughness/transmission are physically plausible suggestions. Bright softbox reflections alone do not justify changing base colors; adjust specular/roughness/light instead. No carbon-fiber finish is supported for these six projects.
coordinatePolicy: All region coordinates refer to raw untransformed STL/GLB positions (mm-scale exports). New sources retain included input face counts and exact bounds; no pose edits or simplification.
consumption: For each key merge projects[key].catalogPatch into catalog.json. New node names are mat_<bucket>; materials keys omit mat_. Alternatively preserveMaterials=true uses embedded PBR, but procedural wood/pearl textures are not embedded. Sources are offline render inputs, not website downloads.
